summary: Meta Platforms filed a Rule 424(b)(5) preliminary prospectus supplement for a multi-tranche offering of five series of senior unsecured notes, with principal amounts, coupons, and maturities left blank in this subject-to-completion version. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, ranking pari passu with existing unsecured senior indebtedness, issued in registered form with $2,000 minimum denominations and optional make-whole-style redemption before maturity. Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are joint book-running managers. This is an ordinary investment-grade debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, spreads, and any capex-funding signal.
